subject: design-technology

moments.title: Rams joins Braun
moments.body:
Rams begins designing radios and household appliances at Braun, working with the Ulm School of Design.

The combination of Bauhaus-influenced education and post-war manufacturing produces a distinctive product language.
moments.takeaway: Industrial design careers were shaped by particular regional ecosystems.

moments.title: Ten principles articulated
moments.body:
Rams begins to articulate what 'good design' means in a series of lectures and writings.

The ten principles are codified in subsequent decades.
moments.takeaway: Long practice preceded the explicit framework most often cited.

moments.title: Apple's stated influence
moments.body: Apple designers publicly acknowledge Rams's influence on iPod, iPhone and macOS calculator aesthetics.
moments.takeaway: Influence can skip companies and decades through individual education.

now.title: Product design today
now.body: Sustainability, repairability and right-to-repair legislation challenge product cultures that prioritise sleek minimalism. Rams's tenth principle ('as little design as possible') is read in new contexts.
now.open_questions: How should design balance aesthetic minimalism against serviceability? What is good design under a circular-economy framework?

reflection: Influential design philosophies often crystallise in industrial settings before reaching schools and the public.
